$description: Penpot-only: layer-opacity switches that show one of two stacked shapes per theme, for things a token can't recolor (the light and dark static maps on the Audio post type board). Bind a shape's opacity to one of these. The site does this with <picture>/prefers-color-scheme, so no CSS reads this file. Pushed into theme/light and theme/dark by build-penpot-tokens.js, names verbatim.
